It was built by OpenAI and is designed to answer questions, write text, help with code, explain concepts, and act as a productivity assistant in many contexts. Key Features General-purpose AI: Good across many domains — conversation, writing, coding, summarization, reasoning.

DeepSeek What It Is (Non-Technical) DeepSeek is a Chinese open-source/partially open language model family focused on efficiency and reasoning with large contexts. It competes with big Western LLMs while keeping coss lower. Key Features ● Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture: activates a subset of parameters per task to reduce compute. ●

architecture: activates a subset of parameters per task to reduce compute. ● Trained on large multilingual corpora with an emphasis on math, logic, and coding. ● Offers high reasoning performance on specialized benchmarks.
